title: Chapter 506
text:
The Bell of Death Island was located on another continent, and it would take an hour to return to the sanctuary. The spaceship maintained a low speed within the planet's atmosphere, but it was still much faster than a plane.

Han Xiao placed the little bastards on the Bell of Death Island in the guest room and did not bother about them anymore. He went to find Hannes and continued the topic.

Hannes described what had happened to him after he went missing. After the Germinal Organization War ended, he had led the team of archaeologists to embark on a journey to find new secrets. As Han Xiao had made the players complete quite a number of mission requirements, Hannes and the others had obtained new information. They had found new suspicious points in the vast number of files, and the clues actually pointed to the Hundred Countries War on Planet Aquamarine.

In the past, the Blue Star had more than a hundred countries. Although there were some conflicts, it was generally peaceful and filled with curiosity about the universe. As Godora appeared and brought knowledge of the universe, they learned that too many countries were slowing down the development of civilization. The waste of resources was extremely high, and they would be trapped on the planet until they died.

Due to the different positions of the countries, no one was willing to give up their sovereignty. Even if they knew that there would be a tragedy in the future, due to various reasons, before the crisis really hit them, most people would choose to be short-sighted. The conflicts became more and more intense, and in the end, military force seemed to be the only path.

Therefore, because of this internal friction theory, a world war broke out a few decades ago. Many countries were destroyed in the war, and only six countries were left. They underwent a huge reshuffle and completed the integration of resources. However, the negative effects of the war had not been eliminated until today.

Hannes did not think that a theory could cause more than a hundred countries to go to war. He believed that there was definitely a mastermind behind the war. After some searching, they finally made new progress and brought about their destruction. The leader should be Nagojin. It's easier to talk to people I know.

He shook his head and did not really care about the truth. After all, the conflict between civilizations had nothing to do with right or wrong. It was just a battle of positions.

Even if Godora really did it, the Blue Star now had to rely on them to provide disaster relief. With so many lives at stake, it was impossible to be stubborn.

Compared to the past, he was more concerned about food and vegetables. Just like when eating, people always had to ignore the source of their food. For example, when growing vegetables, they had to use feces, and when feeding pigs, they had to use swill. When drinking milk, not many people would care about what the first person who knew that milk could be drunk was doing.

Also, when marrying a wife, unless one's luck was exceptionally good, one had to selectively ignore the fact that one had a brother-in-law …

If a friend had passed away, at the cremation memorial service, when everyone closed their eyes to mourn, Han Technician would be the kind of person who would add firewood to the fire. Needless to say, he was pragmatic!

Therefore, from Han Xiao's perspective, no matter what the truth of history was, the value that could be created in the future was more important.

…

After returning to the sanctuary, Han Xiao got the mercenaries to guard the prisoners on Bell of Death Island. Although these arrogant fellows were all captured, they still needed to be trained before they could be used. He was very assured to leave this job to the mercenaries.

Although these prisoners all thought highly of themselves and only lacked the words' I am a bad guy 'written on their faces, compared to the interstellar mercenaries who had killed countless species in different galaxies, they were simply like kind little sheep.

In the next ten days, Han Xiao gradually took action. The magic type mercenaries greatly increased the production of the suppressants, and they were able to supply them to the refugees in the sanctuary on a large scale, stabilizing the situation.

At the same time, more refugees came to the sanctuary, and it was very crowded. Therefore, Bennett started to expand the sanctuary. With the help of the players, the construction progress was extremely fast.

There was an endless stream of refugees, and at this rate, the sanctuary would most likely be expanded into a large city.

Han Xiao did not forget about the Six Nations. Since the Six Nations had agreed, he got some mercenaries to bring some materials and took a spaceship directly to the capital of the Six Nations. The civilians in the city who did not know what was going on were all stunned.

After the two sides reached an agreement, some mercenaries stayed in the Six Nations to help them create the suppressants. The Six Nations were also veterans, and they made a big fuss about the suppressants. After a few shows, the people's confidence gradually returned, and order slowly returned.

The Six Nations naturally did not compromise verbally with Han Xiao. Han Xiao had the authority to mobilize their armies, planes, tanks, warships, and all kinds of war equipment. As long as Han Xiao said a word, he would be able to get them. However, there was no need for him to do so. He had no use for them, and it was better to leave them to the Six Nations to share the burden of the Sanctuary.

The resistance of the Sanctuary and the Six Nations against the Mutation Disaster had a small effect, but the number of refugees saved was just a drop in the ocean compared to the number of lives on the planet. There was no way to deal with the wild beasts and plants, and the most terrifying ones were the sea creatures. Their numbers were several times that of the beasts on land, and they were also affected by the Mutation Disaster. There were even amphibious beasts that had come to land, and a few coastal cities had already been severely damaged.

Therefore, the situation of the Mutation Disaster was still extremely severe, and it was still worsening.

Most of the Blue Star players stayed in the Sanctuary, which was not beneficial to the overall situation. However, it was extremely beneficial to Han Xiao. He had obtained a large amount of experience, and through the Black Star selection ceremony, he had recruited a total of thirty to forty thousand players.

This kind of selection ceremony had become one of the daily activities of the players, and the discussion on the forums was intense. They shared their experiences, and the conclusion was that an iron head was like a firework. Only by being stubborn could one live forever. Instead of slaughtering an entire city, it was better to wait for one person.

Because it was a group selection, the players gradually started to form teams. The casual players tried their luck, the professional players showed off their skills, and the large guilds used their peripheral members to protect the core members.

Those who had not passed the thirty-second test of 'True Man' could not miss this opportunity. Every time they saw Mad Blade, Hao Tian, and the others with high-grade equipment swaggering through the streets, the other players could not help but feel envious. If not for the fact that fighting was not allowed in the Sanctuary, many of them would have tried to kill them to see if they could obtain equipment.

With the cooperation of the players, the passing rate of the selection had increased significantly. The players even thought that they had found the trick … but that was exactly what Han Xiao liked them to think.

Han Xiao had prepared for a long time, and everything was going according to his plan. Most of it was good news … except for one thing, which he did not expect.

The players had actually learned how to play the Wayne Cards from Herlous, and more and more people were addicted to playing cards!

When Han Xiao found out about this, he wished he could strangle Herlous to death. You only know how to play cards every day, and you even led a professional foot soldier astray. Are you trying to force me to sell my card packs?
